name: NIST IV&V Metrology, CNC DFM, Release Review & Offline Security Verification Release
summary: Pro3DWorks v3.2.1 resolves every critical and high-priority engineering, geometry, unit-conversion, security, and browser lifecycle finding identified in the 8-domain NIST IV&V audit — hardening watertight mass validation, zonal cut perimeters, rotating-calipers RFQ OBBs, CNC DFM bore/slot/corner reach, strict biarc G1 chord tolerance, deterministic Release Review reconciliation, AI prompt-injection defenses, and strict offline egress blocking.

highlights.title: Feature-Level CNC DFM in RFQ Intake & Machining Readiness
highlights.text: Named, versioned 3-axis rules evaluate bore/cavity access, concave internal corners vs. candidate cutter radius, and narrow/deep slot accessibility against Illustrative Guideline or Local Shop profiles — separating outside-profile blockers, cost drivers, and honest not_evaluated coverage gates with 3D locator focus and reviewer dispositions.

highlights.title: Evidence-Linked Release Review (STEP / Drawing / BOM)
highlights.text: Reconciles confirmed 3D model, governing PDF drawing, AP242 PMI relationships, and external BOM CSVs (with explicit user-approved occurrence mappings), enforces snapshot stale detection, links discrete evidence IDs to AI review suggestions, and requires explicit human sign-off to resolve discrepancies.

highlights.title: Managed Offline Desktop Policy & Enterprise Runbook
highlights.text: Supports HKLM Group Policy Registry, %ProgramData% policy.json, and PRO3DWORKS_POLICY_PATH with strict fail-closed validation ('no_external_network' disables updates, telemetry, cloud AI, and online licensing while allowing pre-staged local loopback bridges & signed offline Ed25519 keys), accompanied by a CycloneDX SBOM, Outbound-Data Matrix, and IT Deployment Runbook.

highlights.title: Single-Part RFQ Intake, Direct DXF Preflight & AI Engineer Integration
highlights.text: PCA OBB stock envelopes, withheld-on-invalid solid mass, Waterjet 2D Studio DXF preflight & Overkill diff approval, plus full AI Engineer Chat, Command Palette, Local Engineer Q&A, and Design Review integration.

notes: All CAD geometry, RFQ intake, CNC DFM, DXF preflight, Release Review reconciliation, PDF-to-DXF/DWG conversions, and GPU renders run locally on your workstation — zero customer model uploads.
Managed offline mode ('no_external_network') provides technical egress controls and is not a claim of organizational ISO/IEC 27001 certification or TISAX assessment.
OpenCascade / occt-import-js (LGPL-2.1) is shipped in separate relinkable desktop files alongside LICENSE.md; see docs/SBOM.cdx.json.
